title: Aya 23 Public Launch
summary: Cohere For AI announced Aya 23 on May 23, 2024 as a family of multilingual generative language models covering 23 languages, with 8B and 35B parameter open-weight models. The accompanying primary technical report was submitted the same day and describes the Aya 23 family and release of both models' open weights.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in the Aya multilingual model family, documenting a deliberate depth-over-breadth experiment across 23 languages and release of 8B and 35B open-weight models.
